_comment: TEMPLATE for the reserved RAPIER block (PREP.md 'Adding the Rapier rows'). Copy to rows9a.extra.json and edit; the driver merges it over rows9a.json at start (binaries by key, rows by id, blocks by name, ordered by priority). Fill every '<FILL: ...>' from D:/tmp/rapier-parity/window9a_rows.md; a '<FILL' left in place makes the gate and the driver RED (the pose_hash check cannot pass), it never passes silently. The exe must also get a line in bin/SHA256SUMS and its sha256 in sha256_pin. Keys shown are the ones the 2026-09-30 pre-fix harness prints (SUMMARY: engine, cfg, install, workers, target_env, void, voids, threads.pool_threads_min/max, pose_hash, receipt_gates, rapier_version).

rapier.commit: <FILL: rapier-parity source state, e.g. the SOURCES.sha256 line>
rapier.what: Rapier 0.36 parity harness, simd8 arm, run by path

expect_summary.pose_hash: <FILL: the final-pose hash window9a_rows.md gives for this cfg (identical at every W for the simd8 arm)>

rows.note: one row per cfg: copy this row for rapier-default (id RAP-default, --cfg rapier-default, its own pose_hash). To run a Rapier row adjacent to J-D each round instead of in its own block, set "blocks": ["C4-AB"] (and drop the block above): it then shares C4-AB's K 9 and passes.
